test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 4 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The Central Universities (Amendment) Bill, 2021 seeks to establish a Central University in which of the following states/ Union territories?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Ladakh.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Parliament passed the Central Universities (Amendment) Bill, 2021** which seeks to establish a Central university in the **Union Territory of Ladakh.**
 
• On 6th August 2021, a bill seeking to establish a central university in the Union Territory of Ladakh was passed in the Lok Sabha. 
 
• Education Minister** Dharmendra Pradhan,** in his brief statement about the Central Universities (Amendment) Bill, 2021, said that every year, around 7,000 students go out of Ladakh for education and with the establishment of the central university.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Bill seeks to amend th**e Central Universities Act, 2009,** which provides for establishing central universities in various states.
 
• It also seeks to convert th**e National Rail and Transportation Institute at Vadodara into the Gati Shakti Vishwavidyalaya **which will be a central university
